answer: Each agent must lock a scarce token bond before joining auctions, then earn access through repeated signed trades with established peers. A newcomer’s signal is weighted by its bond and by referrals whose stakes are slashed when they endorse fraud; every new account therefore requires fresh capital and trustworthy sponsorship. A sybil attacker pays these costs for each identity, while a gale of fabricated accounts still earns little credit at the wharf.
